title_or_filename: Zhao M., Dang H., Fan C., Chen Z. (2018) hygro peizo.pdf; DOI 10.1007/s10704-018-0320-9
rejection_reason: not a wave problem: the article develops a three-dimensional steady-state general solution for a hygro-thermo-piezoelectric medium and applies it to a crack problem, with no incident, reflected, transmitted or guided wave; the string wave does not occur anywhere in the extracted text
missing_evidence: no wave field, no wave speeds, no dispersion relation, no reflection or transmission coefficient and no wave boundary condition
followup_needed: no follow-up unless the atlas is later widened to static and fracture problems

rejection_reason: not accepted as a wave problem in this batch: the article solves a normal-mode boundary-value problem for the dynamic response of a fiber-reinforced half-space to a moving internal heat source with magnetic field and gravity, and reports only distributions of displacement, temperature and stress against depth; it defines no wave speeds, no dispersion relation and no reflection or transmission coefficients
missing_evidence: no wave incidence, no reflection or transmission coefficients, no speed or dispersion results; the normal-mode field is harmonic along the boundary but the paper never treats it as a propagating wave problem
followup_needed: re-examine if the atlas scope is widened to include half-space normal-mode response problems; the full formulation, boundary conditions (63)-(65) and constant list are recorded in the batch notes

title_or_filename: Li Y., Zhang P., Li C., He T. (2019) mdd + fractional.pdf; DOI 10.1016/j.ijheatmasstransfer.2019.118664
rejection_reason: not a wave problem: the article computes the transient thermomechanical response of a two-layered structure heated by a non-Gaussian laser pulse using the Laplace transform and numerical inversion, with no plane-wave incidence, reflection or transmission analysis
missing_evidence: no wave field, no reflection or transmission coefficients, no dispersion relation; the layer interface is crossed by a diffusion-type thermal disturbance, not by an analysed wave
followup_needed: no follow-up unless the atlas is widened to laser-pulse transient heat transfer in layered media

title_or_filename: Guo H., Li C., Tian X. (2019) 2019Amodifiedfractional-ordergeneralizedpiezoelectric_Guohuili.pdf; DOI 10.1080/01495739.2018.1522987
rejection_reason: not a wave problem in the atlas sense: the article computes the one-dimensional transient thermoelectromechanical response of a thin piezoelectric plate under a thermal shock on one face, using Kirchhoff assumptions and the Laplace transform; the only wave content is the position of the thermal and elastic wave fronts (Eqs. (66)-(67)), which is used to bound the time window and is compared with a published front position, not to analyse a wave field
missing_evidence: no incident or reflected wave, no wave speed as a function of wavenumber, no dispersion relation and no reflection or transmission coefficient
followup_needed: no follow-up unless the atlas is widened to hyperbolic transient heat conduction in thin plates
